title: Staging Bench Rate Card: Autopilot Staging on Staged Endpoint Re-Quotes
content:
**Rate.** The staging charge per unit of a Hardware Procurement staged re-quote, the re-quote of a cancelled Standard Endpoint Order line onto a Staged Endpoint Order, is **55.00 USD** when the client holds an E5 plan or a Premium or E3 plan and an active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement, **70.00 USD** when it holds such a plan and no active ClearPath agreement, and **95.00 USD** for every other client.

**Plans.** The client's Microsoft 365 plan is read once from its Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscriptions whose status is active: it holds an E5 plan when it has an active Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) subscription, and a Premium or E3 plan when it has an active Microsoft 365 Business Premium or Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) subscription; a subscription in any other status gives it neither.

**Agreement.** An active ClearPath agreement is a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement whose status is active.

## Rate matrix

| Microsoft 365 plan held | Active ClearPath agreement | Staging charge per unit |
|---|---|---|
| E5 plan | Yes | 55.00 |
| E5 plan | No | 70.00 |
| Premium or E3 plan | Yes | 55.00 |
| Premium or E3 plan | No | 70.00 |
| Neither (for example only Microsoft 365 Business Basic, F3 or Business Standard, or no active subscription) | Yes | 95.00 |
| Neither | No | 95.00 |

A Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) subscription that is suspended or cancelled gives no E5 plan; a client whose only Business Premium subscription has lapsed holds no Premium or E3 plan.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

For 10 units the staging charge is 550.00 at 55.00, 700.00 at 70.00 and 950.00 at 95.00.
